version.changelog:
- Removed Get Box utility and all references to native binding-site extraction via ligand or known holo structures.
- Updated binding-site acquisition to use only fpocket for predicting pockets from apo protein structures.
- Adjusted workflow guidance and documentation to match the removal of Get Box and focus exclusively on fpocket for binding-site detection.
- No changes to code or implementation files; update is documentation-only.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed SciMiner cloud docking integration that needs an API key and uploads molecular files for the requested docking work.

dimensions.detail: The molecular docking purpose matches the documented capabilities, supported engines, registry helper, file uploads, and SciMiner API invocation flow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to SciMiner docking and registry-defined payloads; the skill strongly directs use of SciMiner, but this is disclosed and aligned with the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No hidden installer or automatic setup was found; credential creation is manual and includes restrictive file permissions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Uploading receptor, ligand, reference-ligand, and docking parameters to SciMiner is expected for cloud docking, but these inputs can contain sensitive research data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill uses a persistent user-level SciMiner API key file and suggests remembering only the credential path; no background worker, self-propagation, destructive action, or unrelated privilege behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this only if you intend to use SciMiner for docking. Keep the API key private, avoid placing credential-handling instructions in shared project files unless appropriate, and do not upload confidential, proprietary, or regulated molecular data unless SciMiner's terms and security controls meet your needs.
llm.findings:
[E1] expected: External transmission to sciminer.tech is the core execution path and is disclosed through the upload and invocation instructions; it is a privacy boundary, not hidden exfiltration.
[PE3] expected: Reading ~/.config/sciminer/credentials.json is disclosed and used to authenticate SciMiner requests; the artifact instructs agents not to print or store the key value.
[RA2] expected: Persistent credential storage is explicitly user-configured and limited to the SciMiner key path; it increases operational risk but is not hidden or unrelated to the skill.
